e19_selfreport.statement: No directory listing, glob or recursive search was run anywhere, in the corpus or in my own scratch. Every corpus path opened is named in my brief's input table, plus the authority ledger and the active-worktree registry named by the launch message and my policy (each opened by exact path, the ledger read by a content search for the OW-11 addendum only, the registry for the lane's entry only). Every pinned input was hashed when read and matched the table; no digest changed. The gate's work directory was created with makedirs, never tested for.

limit: Two gate runs, the number the brief allows. Run 1 on the draft returned ALL_CLEAN with no hard member gaining a flag and nothing to fix; the read-back then changed one field's bytes (P04-013 device_notes: a doubled parenthesis smoothed), so run 2 was made on the delivered bytes, as the owner's directive allows when a read-back changes them. No third run. Built in one pass by a single script; every lane text adopted verbatim or by exact-substring replacement; the P04-013 row written whole.
